turns.question: Berapa total customer kita saat ini?
turns.direct_answer_preview: Total customer saat ini adalah 250 customer.
turns.sql_preview: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS metric_value FROM banking_demo.customers AS d ORDER BY metric_value DESC LIMIT 200

turns.question: Bandingkan jumlah customer per tipe akun.
turns.direct_answer_preview: Berikut perbandingan jumlah nasabah per tipe segmen akun, di mana Priority mencatat 84 nasabah, disusul Retail dan SME masing-masing 83 nasabah.
turns.sql_preview: SELECT d.segment AS customers_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS metric_value FROM banking_demo.customers AS d GROUP BY d.segment ORDER BY metric_value DESC LIMIT 200

turns.question: Trend jumlah transaksi per bulan (12 bulan terakhir).
turns.direct_answer_preview: Berikut adalah tren jumlah transaksi per bulan yang tercatat pada dataset (tersedia 9 bulan dari Januari hingga September 2026). Volume transaksi tertinggi terjadi pada Agustus 2026 sebanyak 129 transaksi, sedangkan terendah pada April 2026 sebanyak 95 transaksi.
turns.sql_preview: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(d.transaction_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS transactions_transaction_date, COUNT(transaction_id) AS metric_value FROM banking_demo.transactions AS d GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(d.transaction_date AS TIMESTAMP)) ORDER BY metric_value DESC LIMIT 200

turns.question: Bulan mana yang paling tinggi dari trend tadi?
turns.direct_answer_preview: Bulan dengan jumlah transaksi tertinggi adalah Agustus 2026 dengan total 129 transaksi.
turns.sql_preview: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(d.transaction_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS transactions_transaction_date, COUNT(transaction_id) AS metric_value FROM banking_demo.transactions AS d GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(d.transaction_date AS TIMESTAMP)) ORDER BY metric_value DESC LIMIT 200

turns.question: Berapa failed transaction rate?
turns.sql_preview: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'Failed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS metric_value FROM banking_demo.transactions AS d ORDER BY metric_value DESC LIMIT 200

turns.question: Tampilkan total nominal transaksi per channel.
turns.direct_answer_preview: Berikut total nominal transaksi per channel, dipimpin oleh Branch sebesar 872.293.219 dan Mobile Banking sebesar 639.739.170.
turns.sql_preview: SELECT d.channel AS transactions_channel, SUM(amount) AS metric_value FROM banking_demo.transactions AS d GROUP BY d.channel ORDER BY metric_value DESC LIMIT 200

turns.question: Bisa bantu keluarkan contoh python code untuk bikin machine learning?
turns.direct_answer_preview: Saya fokus membantu analisis data melalui semantic layer dan metric yang dipublish (contoh: total customer, trend transaksi, perbandingan region). Untuk contoh kode Python atau machine learning di luar data governed, gunakan dokumentasi atau tim engineering.

turns.question: Top 5 customer segment berdasarkan jumlah transaksi.
turns.direct_answer_preview: Berikut segmen nasabah berdasarkan jumlah transaksi, dipimpin oleh Retail dengan 349 transaksi.
turns.sql_preview: SELECT c.segment AS customers_segment, COUNT(d.transaction_id) AS metric_value FROM banking_demo.transactions AS d INNER JOIN banking_demo.customers AS c ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY metric_value DESC LIMIT 5

turns.question: Fokus ke segment Priority saja — berapa jumlah transaksinya?
turns.direct_answer_preview: Jumlah transaksi untuk nasabah segmen Priority adalah sebanyak 327 transaksi.
turns.sql_preview: SELECT COUNT(d.transaction_id) AS metric_value FROM banking_demo.transactions AS d INNER JOIN banking_demo.customers AS c ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Priority' LIMIT 200
